nodes.klein: to cleave, split, divide. was divided. he cleft; he divided. was divided. was divided. he separated (orig. ‘he divided’); he went off (lit.: ‘he separated himself’); for sense development cp. Fren. partir (= to divide, separate), se partir (= to separate oneself, depart, leave); he set sail; he turned aside, diverted, put off; he removed; he exaggerated (lit. prob. meaning ‘he went too far’). was diverted; was removed.

nodes.g: to divide, cut in two, cut short, live half (of one's life)
to pass over or by or through, alienate, bring, carry, do away, take, take away…
to divide, share, plunder, allot, apportion, assign to be smooth, slippery, deceitful
to be divided into, divide, branch off
